1.consolidated_definition: "Tuberculoso": Que padece tuberculosis, enfermedad infecciosa que afecta principalmente los pulmones y se caracteriza por la formación de granulomas en el tejido pulmonar.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Pulmonary tuberculosis sufferer: One who suffers from pulmonary tuberculosis, a contagious disease that primarily affects the lungs and is characterized by the formation of granulomas in lung tissue.
